description.value: PickEco Refills is an eco-friendly refill and apothecary store operating out of Chilliwack's District 1881 heritage shopping complex, where customers bring their own containers to refill with zero-waste cleaning and personal care products. It is a distinctive stop for environmentally conscious travellers passing through the Fraser Valley. Cyclists may find it useful for biodegradable soaps and cleaning supplies suitable for touring.
